items.title: Theographic verse-year source and convention
items.citation: Theographic, Chronology and Dates: Verse years (yearNum); pinned commit 744355c7a5f38efd407bc67a5257c99aca9532bc
items.summary: The imported verse placements follow Ussher through Torrey's marginal chronology. They are distinct from the dataset's Jones event timeline.
items.dating_method: Attributed marginal chronology, projected through explicit reference mappings
items.scope: Explains the imported source estimate; does not independently date composition or every event mentioned
items.uncertainty: Approximate source year; differing chronology traditions and reference-level projection remain visible

items.title: Theographic event chronology
items.citation: Theographic, Chronology and Dates: Jones framework and Acts contribution by Todd Atwood
items.summary: The event layer uses a different chronology from verse years. A source event's start and duration do not establish the setting date of every associated verse.
items.dating_method: Source event chronology and dependency metadata
items.scope: Event association only; retained calendar-day precision belongs to the source claim
items.uncertainty: Model-dependent chronology; imported exact-looking dates are not independent historical verification

items.title: User's relative Adam-creation anchor
items.citation: User-confirmed model premise, 2026-11-01: approximately 4,000 years before the resurrection
items.summary: Subtract approximately 4,000 elapsed years from the selected AD 30 or AD 33 resurrection scenario. The result is a conditional model placement.
items.dating_method: Explicit relative premise and astronomical-year arithmetic
items.scope: Cited Adam-creation narrative context only; other dates are not recalculated
items.uncertainty: Premise and resurrection-year scenario are not archaeological measurements

items.title: Adam-creation narrative context
items.summary: These passages identify the creation narrative to which the model premise is applied. They do not supply an absolute BC date.
items.dating_method: Explicit narrative context; absolute placement supplied separately by the model premise
items.scope: Contextual association, not independent support for the 4,000-year interval
items.uncertainty: No archaeological date or complete genealogical derivation is claimed

items.title: Pentecost narrative context
items.summary: Acts locates the scene at Pentecost. An absolute AD year comes from an additional chronology model rather than these verses alone.
items.dating_method: Textual festival context plus separately attributed absolute chronology
items.scope: Pentecost association, not a resolution of the AD 30 versus AD 33 difference
items.uncertainty: The competing source placements are retained

items.title: Sennacherib's campaign: Jerusalem Prism
items.citation: Israel Museum, IMJ 71.72.249; exhibition text by Laura A. Peri, December 30, 2025
items.summary: The museum dates the prism to 691 BC and the campaign in Judah under Hezekiah to 701 BC, linking it to the Kings, Isaiah and Chronicles narratives.
items.dating_method: Museum catalog dating of inscribed object and historical campaign; two distinct dates
items.scope: Campaign context for 2 Kings 18:13 and Isaiah 36:1; does not establish the composition date or every narrative detail
items.uncertainty: Year-level historical context; museum attribution verified by Codex, not an independent expert adjudication

provenance.license: Original short summary and catalog link; no museum image or transcription copied

items.title: Sennacherib and Hezekiah in the biblical narrative
items.summary: These verses identify Sennacherib's attack in Hezekiah's reign. Correlating the campaign with the museum's chronology is an explicit historical interpretation.
items.dating_method: Regnal narrative correlated with an attributed external campaign chronology
items.scope: Campaign identity only; chronology disagreements remain separate
items.uncertainty: Correlation and source-model differences require continued review
